title: Morning Brief — Tuesday, 24 November 2026
description: The Department of Veterans' Affairs reports dramatically faster claims processing after legislative reform, Queensland completes the first stage of its $500 million Beef Roads Program, and Griffith University climbs nearly 40 places in global university rankings. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
